scope: Read-only saved exterior source inventory; no exports, bindings or regeneration baseline selected.
order: Native layers are preorder, top-to-bottom; smaller sibling/root index draws in front. Sibling indices are zero based.
catalog_mapping_policy: Model/year-qualified literal RPO tokens are location candidates, not binding qualification. Paint tokens map paint only, never the geometry of numeric S-codes. The string unmapped means no identified catalog option. Mapping option_ids resolve in catalog_options[source.model_key]; the source fixes model/year. Root index is the sibling_index of the native ancestor with null parent_id; per-component contract text is factored into component_contracts. Configuration candidates are not catalog options.

tint_decision.scope: Every exterior scene, model/body/trim/paint/view; all windshield, side, rear/hatch, quarter/van glass and transparent roof where present.
tint_decision.placement: Opaque masked fill above all cabin content in each glass opening, below retained glass reflections and defroster strokes. Preserve body/roof occlusion.
tint_decision.qualification: Recipe identical; source-specific masks/depth placements remain unrendered. No single global insertion is qualified.
